name: checkpoint
description: One-click safety snapshots of your working tree (untracked files too) that never touch your branch, index or stash. /checkpoint, list, diff, restore, drop. Restore shows what would be lost and asks first.

enabled.title: Enable /checkpoint
enabled.description: Turn off to make /checkpoint do nothing.

autoBeforePrompt.title: Snapshot automatically
autoBeforePrompt.description: When on, a snapshot named auto-<time> is made at the first prompt of a turn that follows file changes.

maxAuto.title: Automatic snapshots kept
maxAuto.description: How many auto-<time> snapshots to keep. Older automatic ones are deleted. Your own named snapshots are never deleted by this.
